description: The Altiora Codex Oracle is a digital environment for personal, spiritual, and creative reflection. Users can open one-card, three-card, or five-card readings and, for multi-card readings, choose between a Full Reading, Core Message, or Personal Transmission. The Oracle supports both English and Dutch, and readings can be saved as a document or PDF. It is intended for personal reflection and inspiration and does not replace medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
